title: ISRO Assistant & Junior Personal Assistant Admit Card 2026
organization: Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) / Centralised Recruitment Board (ICRB)
postName: Assistant, Junior Personal Assistant (JPA), Upper Division Clerk (UDC) and Stenographer (Advt. ISRO:ICRB:01(A-JPA):2026)
vacancyDetails: 242 posts: Assistant / UDC 150 posts and Junior Personal Assistant / Stenographer 92 posts under ISRO ICRB recruitment 2026.
qualification: Graduation with minimum 60% marks or CGPA equivalent for Assistant / UDC posts; graduation or diploma in commercial/secretarial practice with stenography speed and computer proficiency for Junior Personal Assistant / Stenographer posts as per the official bilingual ISRO notification.
ageLimit: Minimum age: N/A. Maximum age: 28 years for General, 31 years for OBC, 33 years for SC/ST. Applicable age relaxation as per ISRO ICRB rules.
applicationFee: General / OBC / EWS ₹500 (₹400 refundable after appearing in written test). SC / ST / All Female ₹500 (₹500 refundable after appearing in written test). Payment modes: Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Card / Mobile Wallet.
selectionProcess: Pre Exam / Written Test → Mains Exam → Group Exercise → Interview
documentsRequired: Registration number / enrollment number, date of birth or login credentials, printed admit card, valid photo ID and original certificates as required by the ISRO recruitment instructions.
howToApply:
1. Visit the official ISRO admit card login portal
2. Open the ICRB recruitment page for Advt. ISRO:ICRB:01(A-JPA):2026
3. Click the admit card or login link
4. Enter registration / enrollment number and date of birth or password
5. Download the admit card and take a printout
6. Check the exam date, reporting time, venue and instructions carefully.
shortDescription: ISRO Assistant & Junior Personal Assistant Admit Card 2026 for Assistants, JPAs, UDCs and Stenographers is now available through the official ISRO ICRB portal.
content:
Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) has released the Admit Card for the recruitment of Assistant, Junior Personal Assistant (JPA), Upper Division Clerk (UDC) and Stenographer posts under Advt. No. ISRO:ICRB:01(A-JPA):2026.

The exam is scheduled on 21 September 2026. The admit card is available on the official ISRO portal and can be downloaded using the candidate registration / enrollment number and date of birth or login password.

Important Dates

  • Online Apply Start Date: 27 July 2026
  • Online Apply Last Date: 20 August 2026 Extended
  • Last Date for Fee Payment: 20 August 2026
  • Pre Exam Date: 21 September 2026
  • Pre Admit Card: 10 September 2026 Available Now
  • Pre Result: Will Be Updated Here Soon

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS: ₹500 (₹400 refunded after appearing in Written Test)
  • SC / ST / All Female: ₹500 (₹500 refunded after appearing in Written Test)

Vacancy Details

  • Assistant / UDC: 150 posts
  • Junior Personal Assistant / Stenographer: 92 posts

Download the admit card only from the official admit card link and carry the printed hall ticket with a valid photo ID to the examination centre.
